provenance.purpose: Seed replication of the 3B headline run, which reported prose discordant 0.4333 on seed 7 alone. Identical settings, seed 7 -> 123 for BOTH cell sampling and training, matching the protocol of the 1.5B replication in configs/research_polarity_balanced_seed123_v1.json.
provenance.init: the SAME 3B prose-native pilot as the seed-7 run, so stage 2 is held fixed and only stage 3 varies
provenance.CAVEAT_draw_overlap: The redraw is only partly independent. Jaccard vs the seed-7 draw is 0.399 over pairs. The two discordant cells are limiting (552 available, 552 taken) and overlap 95%; the two concordant cells overlap 9%. So this varies training stochasticity and the concordant sample, but the discordant examples are nearly the same pairs by construction. That is inherent to the balanced design, not a defect of this run.
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul non-held-out pairs are training data here as in every other balanced run.
